title: Choose a content-appropriate virtual keyboard

statement.en: Choose a virtual keyboard that matches the content people are editing.
statement.ja: 編集中のcontentに合うvirtual keyboardを選ぶ。

conditions: Use keys optimized for the expected input, such as numbers and punctuation for numeric data.
exceptions: On watchOS, set the text field content type because the keyboard type can't be changed.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Virtual keyboards experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるVirtual keyboardsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does each text-entry context present a virtual keyboard suited to its expected content?
